=== Original Rathdowney baptism of Margaret — 31 October 2026 ===
The original Rathdowney register records '''Margt''' as baptised on '''5 July 1774''' and '''born on 4 July''', infant of '''David Glascow and Anne Ford'''.<ref name="RathdowneyMargaret1774">[https://registers.nli.ie/registers/vtls000631901#page/69/mode/1up Rathdowney Catholic parish register, National Library of Ireland, microfilm 05013/08, image 69, right-hand page, July 1774 Margaret entry]. Original scan inspected by the research assistant, 31 October 2026. Birth and baptism are separately stated; sponsors provisionally read Michl Brophy and Anne Gregory; marginal locality abbreviated and not expanded.</ref> The indexed 5 July date is the baptism, not the birthday. Sponsor readings remain tentative and do not establish kinship; no exact townland is inferred.

This completes the earlier proposed July 1774 original-entry test.
